description: This file implements the Maximal Marginal Relevance (MMR) re-ranking algorithm, including tokenization, similarity computation, and re-ranking functions for search results, with special handling for CJK characters.

methods.name: tokenize
methods.description: Tokenizes input text into a set of ASCII tokens, CJK unigrams, and adjacent CJK bigrams for similarity calculations.

methods.name: jaccardSimilarity
methods.description: Calculates the Jaccard similarity between two sets of tokens.

methods.name: textSimilarity
methods.description: Computes similarity between two text contents using Jaccard similarity on tokenized content.

methods.name: maxSimilarityToSelected
methods.description: Finds the maximum similarity between a given item and a list of selected items.

methods.name: computeMMRScore
methods.description: Calculates the MMR score based on relevance, maximum similarity, and lambda parameter.

methods.name: mmrRerank
methods.description: Performs re-ranking of items using the MMR algorithm, balancing relevance and diversity.

methods.name: applyMMRToHybridResults
methods.description: Applies MMR re-ranking to a list of hybrid search result objects, preserving original structure.
